name: Polymorphism & Dynamic Dispatch
description: CLASS hierarchy, SELECT TYPE, vtable in FIR (fir.dispatch_table), indirect function pointer calls in LLVM IR
source:
subroutine print_shape_info(s)
  class(Shape), intent(in) :: s
  real :: a, per

  a   = s%area()
  per = s%perimeter()

  SELECT TYPE (s)
    TYPE IS (Circle)
      print *, 'Circle: radius=', s%radius
    TYPE IS (Rectangle)
      print *, 'Rect: ', s%width, 'x', s%height
    CLASS DEFAULT
      print *, 'Shape: area=', a
  END SELECT
end subroutine print_shape_info

; ModuleID = '06_polymorphism.f90'
; CLASS(Shape) is represented as a Fortran descriptor box:
;   struct { ptr data, ptr type_descriptor, ... }

; External runtime for type guard comparisons
declare i1 @_FortranAClassIs(ptr, ptr)

define void @_QPprint_shape_info(ptr nocapture readonly %0) #0 !dbg !5 {
entry:
  ; Load the function pointer for 'area' from the type descriptor
  ; Box layout: { data_ptr[0], type_desc_ptr[8], ... }
  %tdesc_ptr  = getelementptr inbounds %Descriptor, ptr %0, i64 0, i32 1, !dbg !10
  %tdesc      = load ptr, ptr %tdesc_ptr, align 8, !dbg !10

  ; Virtual dispatch: load vtable entry for 'area' at fixed offset
  %area_slot  = getelementptr inbounds %TypeDescriptor, ptr %tdesc, i64 0, i32 3, !dbg !10
  %area_fptr  = load ptr, ptr %area_slot, align 8, !dbg !10
  %a_val      = call float %area_fptr(ptr %0), !dbg !10          ; indirect call

  %peri_slot  = getelementptr inbounds %TypeDescriptor, ptr %tdesc, i64 0, i32 4, !dbg !11
  %peri_fptr  = load ptr, ptr %peri_slot, align 8, !dbg !11
  %per_val    = call float %peri_fptr(ptr %0), !dbg !11          ; indirect call

  ; SELECT TYPE — runtime type descriptor comparison
  %circle_desc = load ptr, @_QDTshapesTCircle_desc, align 8, !dbg !12
  %is_circle   = call i1 @_FortranAClassIs(ptr %tdesc, ptr %circle_desc), !dbg !12
  br i1 %is_circle, label %circle_block, label %check_rect, !dbg !12

circle_block:
  ; TYPE IS (Circle): safe downcast, access s%radius at concrete offset
  %r_ptr   = getelementptr inbounds %Circle, ptr %0, i64 0, i32 1, !dbg !13
  %radius  = load float, ptr %r_ptr, align 4, !dbg !13
  ; ... call _FortranAioOutputReal32, etc.
  br label %select_end

check_rect:
  %rect_desc = load ptr, @_QDTshapesTRectangle_desc, align 8
  %is_rect   = call i1 @_FortranAClassIs(ptr %tdesc, ptr %rect_desc)
  br i1 %is_rect, label %rect_block, label %default_block

rect_block:
  ; TYPE IS (Rectangle)
  %w_ptr = getelementptr inbounds %Rectangle, ptr %0, i64 0, i32 1, !dbg !14
  %width = load float, ptr %w_ptr, align 4, !dbg !14
  br label %select_end

default_block:
  ; CLASS DEFAULT
  br label %select_end

select_end:
  ret void, !dbg !15
}

; KEY INSIGHT: fir.dispatch_table entries map to function pointers stored at
; fixed offsets within the type descriptor struct. Dynamic dispatch = two GEPs
; (box → type_desc, type_desc → function_slot) + one indirect call.

correlations.lowering_notes: CLASS(Shape) variables carry a Fortran descriptor box containing a pointer to the concrete type's dispatch table. fir.dispatch in FIR encodes the method name symbolically; it lowers to two GEPs (box→type_descriptor, type_descriptor→method_slot) and an indirect call in LLVM IR. No inlining is possible without devirtualization.

SELECT TYPE compiles to a linear chain of type descriptor comparisons using the _FortranAClassIs runtime function. Each TYPE IS guard becomes a call + conditional branch. On match, the selector is statically downcast (a GEP reinterpretation) to the concrete type, granting direct access to type-specific components without box overhead.
